scripts.dev: bun scripts/gen-meta.ts && brust build routes.tsx && brust start
scripts.build:static: bun scripts/gen-meta.ts && brust build routes.tsx --target static && bun scripts/pages-extras.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run build:static && bunx wrangler pages deploy dist/static --project-name brust-dev --branch main --commit-dirty=true
